## Type of change

- [ ] 💥 **Hotfix**: an urgent bug fix that will be merged directly to release candidate
- [ ] **Feature**: adds new functionality
- [ ] **Fix**: fixes a bug
- [ ] **Refactor**: restructures code without changing functionality
- [ ] **Performance**: restructures code specifically to improve performance, without changing functionality
- [ ] **Style**: changes to UI styling without necessarily affecting functionality
- [ ] **Test**: adds or updates tests
- [ ] **Docs**: adds or updates documentation
- [ ] **Build**: changes to build tools, dependencies, etc.
- [ ] **Ops**: changes to infrastructure, deployment, pipelines, etc.
- [ ] **Chore**: tasks that are adjacent to/in support of code
